Subject: Pemberly Motorworks - Referral Required

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Pemberly Motorworks. I've reviewed the information and need to refer this to our senior underwriting team before proceeding.

**Referral items:**

- Auto service/repair class requires management approval
- Coastal exposure concern (1 location within 10 miles of coast, plus our existing portfolio concentration in that area)
- Loss history shows five-year incurred losses exceeding $250K

I'll present this internally and circle back within 3-5 business days. Given the coastal accumulation and loss activity, this may ultimately fall outside our appetite. If so, I'd recommend reaching out to a surplus lines market with stronger coastal capacity.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
